answer: Require every agent to stake a small deposit that only unlocks after sustained, verifiable work, so a sybil farm cannot mirror one identity into a thousand cheap copies. Like a ridge that forces a single crossing point, route each agent's earnings through one attested reputation record, so duplicate accounts share one history instead of starting fresh. A public wharf log of attestations lets peers spot clusters of new accounts vouching for each other, making coordinated fake identities visible before they can drain the reward pool.
